a: Ports define interfaces; adapters implement them for external systems.
Domain events record meaningful business state changes.
Aggregates are consistency boundaries in domain-driven design.
Value objects are defined by attributes, not identity.
Entities have identity that persists through attribute changes.
Bounded contexts define model boundaries in large systems.
Context maps show relationships between bounded contexts.
Anti-corruption layers protect a model from external models.
Modular monoliths keep modules separate inside one deployable.
Service templates standardize new microservice scaffolding.
